name: xplain
description: Explain code with an LLM agent: collect code blocks into a context, send to your agent, and keep explanations anchored to the code.

commands.title: Toggle Pick Mode (add existing result to context)
Set Up Subscription Harness (Claude Code / Codex via Claudexor)...

enumDescriptions: Your own agent service speaking the XPlain HTTP contract (xplain.agent.endpoint).
Hermes Agent API server (OpenAI-compatible, default http://127.0.0.1:8642/v1).
OpenAI / Codex (API): OpenAI Chat Completions or any compatible server; needs an API key.
Anthropic / Claude (API): Anthropic Messages API; needs an API key.
OpenAI / Codex (Subscription): your ChatGPT Plus/Pro login through the Codex CLI, driven by the bundled Claudexor. No API key.
Anthropic / Claude (Subscription): your Claude Pro/Max login through Claude Code, driven by the bundled Claudexor. No API key.
Cursor Agent SDK (@cursor/sdk) running locally against this workspace.
Built-in offline mock answer (for demos and development).
xplain.agent.provider.description: Which backend answers XPlain requests. Configure it in the panel's Agent tab or here.

xplain.agent.endpoint.description: [xplain provider] HTTP endpoint of your agent system. Receives POST with the context and returns an explanation.

xplain.agent.systemPrompt.description: [hermes/openai/anthropic/cursor] Custom system prompt. Empty uses the built-in XPlain prompt.

xplain.agent.openaiSubscription.model.description: [openaiSubscription] Model id passed to the Codex CLI (e.g. gpt-5.6-codex). Empty = harness default. Uses your ChatGPT subscription via Claudexor; no API key.

xplain.agent.openaiSubscription.effort.description: [openaiSubscription] Reasoning effort hint passed to Claudexor as --effort (minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh; clamped to what the model advertises). Empty = default.

xplain.agent.anthropicSubscription.model.description: [anthropicSubscription] Model id passed to Claude Code (e.g. claude-sonnet-5). Empty = harness default. Uses your Claude Pro/Max subscription via Claudexor; no API key.

xplain.agent.anthropicSubscription.effor.description: [anthropicSubscription] Reasoning effort hint passed to Claudexor as --effort (low/medium/high/xhigh/max; clamped to what the model advertises). Empty = default.

xplain.agent.claudexor.cliPath.description: Path to a claudexor CLI entry (bin/claudexor.js or a global `claudexor`). Empty = the copy bundled with XPlain.

xplain.agent.claudexor.nodePath.description: Node.js >= 24.15 binary used to run the Claudexor CLI. Empty = auto-detect (managed runtime in global storage, extension host runtime, PATH, nvm, /usr/local/bin) and download one if nothing fits.

xplain.agent.claudexor.autoInstallNode.description: When no Node.js >= 24.15 is found for the Claudexor CLI, download an official build from nodejs.org (checksum-verified) into the extension's global storage. No sudo, PATH untouched.

xplain.agent.claudexor.nodeVersion.description: Exact Node.js version to download for Claudexor (e.g. 24.21.0). Empty = extension default.

enumDescriptions: Read-only `ask` normally; write-capable `agent` run when the Excalidraw checkbox is on (needed to render PNGs).
Always the read-only `ask` route (no file writes; Excalidraw PNG rendering unavailable).
xplain.agent.claudexor.mode.description: Which Claudexor route the subscription providers use.

enumDescriptions: Workspace folder when it is already a git repository; otherwise a private per-workspace dir under the extension's global storage (diagrams are mirrored back to .xplain/diagrams/).
Always the workspace folder. Warning: Claudexor git-inits non-git folders with a baseline commit.
Always the private dir. The agent never sees your project tree (all code is in the prompt).

xplain.agent.cursor.model.description: [cursor] Model id for the Cursor Agent SDK (from Cursor.models.list(), e.g. composer-2.5).

xplain.agent.cursor.effort.description: [cursor] Reasoning effort / thinking level mapped onto the model's effort parameter from Cursor.models.list() (levels shown in the Agent tab). Empty = model default.

xplain.agent.cursor.useSandbox.description: [cursor] Enable Cursor local Landlock sandbox. Leave off on Remote-SSH if you see "sandboxing is requested but no sandbox available". Artifact isolation still uses .cursorignore + prompt rules when sandbox is off.

xplain.agent.hermes.baseUrl.description: [hermes] Base URL of the Hermes Agent API server (include /v1). Enable it with API_SERVER_ENABLED=true and API_SERVER_KEY in Hermes.

xplain.agent.hermes.model.description: [hermes] Model name sent to Hermes (profile name; 'hermes-agent' for the default profile).

xplain.agent.openai.baseUrl.description: [openai] Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API (OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM...).

xplain.agent.openai.model.description: [openai] Model id, e.g. a Codex/GPT model. Use 'Test connection' in the Agent tab to list available models.

xplain.agent.openai.effort.description: [openai] reasoning_effort sent with chat completions (none/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh, model-dependent). Empty = model default.

xplain.agent.anthropic.baseUrl.description: [anthropic] Base URL of the Anthropic API.

xplain.agent.anthropic.effort.description: [anthropic] output_config.effort sent with messages (low/medium/high/xhigh/max, model-dependent). Empty = model default.

xplain.agent.timeoutMinutes.description: Idle timeout in minutes (default 10). Time allowed with no activity: waiting for response headers, then silence between body chunks. Any received data (SSE keepalives, tool-progress events, content) resets the timer. Aborting cancels the agent-side request.

xplain.agent.streaming.description: Stream partial output (NDJSON for the xplain provider, SSE for hermes/openai/anthropic, SDK stream for cursor).

xplain.agent.headers.description: Extra HTTP headers sent to any provider. API keys are stored securely (Agent tab) and sent automatically as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (or 'x-api-key' for Anthropic).

xplain.editor.showCodeLens.description: Show a CodeLens above every code block that has explanations.

xplain.editor.highlightBlocks.description: Highlight code blocks with explanations in the editor gutter.

xplain.editor.hideOutdated.description: Hide CodeLens entries for explanations whose code changed heavily (outdated/lost). Sessions are never deleted; they stay in History with a drift badge.

xplain.drift.outdatedRatio.description: Share of changed lines (relative to the explained block) above which an explanation is marked outdated instead of merely 'code changed'. Comment/whitespace-only edits never count.

xplain.drift.driftedMaxLines.description: Absolute number of changed lines above which an explanation is marked outdated regardless of ratio.

enumDescriptions: Refresh overwrites the existing explanation (same session, like Extend).
Refresh creates a new explanation on the same blocks and keeps the old one in History.
xplain.refresh.mode.description: What the Refresh action does when code drifted from an explanation.
